source.read.describe: reads the library and the support ticket from the vault

code.fix.describe: the agent fixes the module; it sees the module, the ticket and the visible tests, never the regression tests
code.fix.instructions: You maintain a small Python module. Fix the bug the support ticket describes, following its accounting rule exactly. Keep every function and its signature; the module may import decimal. The existing tests, which must keep passing: invoice_total([]) == '0.00', invoice_total([[1000, 1, 19]]) == '11.90', invoice_total([[250, 4, 7]]) == '10.70', invoice_total([[1999, 3, 19], [499, 2, 7]]) == '82.04'. Answer with the whole corrected module in the field code, nothing else.

code.test.describe: runs the agent's module against the frozen regression suite in a trusted frame; green is an observation
